ITEM 1 | About 65 whole oval, pointed pieces, tan to medium-brown with a matte, slightly papery surface and fine longitudinal ridges. Piled loosely in a heap covering roughly the central two-thirds of a square white plate (about 26 cm across). Each piece is about 2.5 to 3 cm long and 1.5 cm wide, and they are dry and firm, holding their shape. Some pieces show a pale cream or white patch on one face. No visible oil, sauce, or cooking marks. | 75
ITEM 2 | One tiny pale-yellow speck, about 0.3 cm, sitting on the white plate to the right of the pile, separate from the other pieces. Matte, slightly granular, with no visible sheen. | 0.5
